investmentQuestionnaire.subtitle: Select an option for each question to help us understand your objectives and risk tolerance.
investmentQuestionnaire.q1: What percentage of your liquid assets do you plan to invest?
investmentQuestionnaire.q2: What is your expectation for long-term annualized return and volatility?
investmentQuestionnaire.q3: What is your attitude toward investment volatility?
investmentQuestionnaire.q4: What do you expect to happen to your income while you maintain your investment?
investmentQuestionnaire.q5: What is the objective of your investment?
investmentQuestionnaire.q6: What would you do if your investment fell 10% in 3 months?
investmentQuestionnaire.q6_vender: Would sell all or most of the investment
investmentQuestionnaire.q6_aumentar: Would take advantage to invest more
investmentQuestionnaire.q7: How long do you want to invest this money?
investmentQuestionnaire.infoText: Your answers allow us to define an investment profile aligned with your objectives and risk tolerance.
investmentQuestionnaire.profileGrowthDesc: If you are interested in investing more than US$10,000 and would like to receive personalized investment options, please contact us through the following options.
investmentQuestionnaire.profileConservativeDesc: Profile focused on capital preservation, prioritizing stability and low volatility over time.
investmentQuestionnaire.profileBalancedDesc: Combines growth and protection through a balanced mix of defensive and higher-return assets.
investmentQuestionnaire.profileAggressiveDesc: Focused on maximizing capital growth, accepting higher volatility in the short and medium term.
